mapper.select: select from user_browse_history where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0 order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into user_browse_history ( id, user_id, sku_id, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) values ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{skuId}, now(), now(), 0 )
mapper.update: update user_browse_history set is_deleted = 1, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0
